facts.text: Evan grew up on a small island that he describes as his happy place.

evidence.quote: This little island is where I grew up and it's my happy place.

facts.text: Evan describes the island as a place that shaped him and holds a special place in his heart.

evidence.quote: That place shaped me and will always hold a special place in my heart.

facts.text: Sam finds the island to be a peaceful and stunning location.

evidence.quote: That spot looks gorgeous. Growing up there must have been so peaceful and stunning.

facts.text: Sam comments on the calming effect of the island, describing it as serene and calming.

evidence.quote: It really is. So serene and calming.
